title: Pricing schemes made in Settings > Sales never apply on the Sales demand form
summary: Schemes made in Settings > Sales never apply on `/sales-demand/demand-order/new`. An active "10% off Item A for Modern Trade, 10+ units" scheme (SCH-000001) gave discount 0.00 on a 20-unit Modern Trade demand. Only the Field Force ASE create-demand screen sends `appliedPricingSchemaId`; the sales demand form sends none (code comment in `sales-demand-form-item-row.tsx`). The backend only injects promo free lines when the line carries a scheme id. So discount, cashback and promo schemes cannot be used from the Sales module at all. Decision: should the sales demand form suggest or auto-apply schemes?
status_evidence: reproduced in the browser, sales test 2026-11-11

title: VAT shown is not the VAT posted
summary: VAT shown is not the VAT posted. Document screens show "VAT 15.8%, 25.28" on a 160.00 Modern Trade line. The invoice line holds tax_rate 0.158, tax_amount 25.28 but vat_amount 24.00 (15%) and ait_amount 1.28 (0.8%). The ledger gets Output VAT 24.00 and the AIT 1.28 stays inside Sales (136.00 = 160 - 24) because no AIT ledger is mapped. By design the Modern Trade channel is flat: 15.8% of the inclusive price, not the tax inside the price (that would be 20.87). The UI calls the whole 15.8% "VAT".
status_evidence: reproduced in the browser, sales test 2026-11-11

title: Pricing-scheme discount and cashback lost after Confirm Quantities: demand, invoice and journal carry the higher price
summary: The pricing-scheme discount is lost between the ASE screen and the invoice. ASE review shows 66.96 (scheme 8.00 + trade 5.04). After "Confirm Quantities" the demand is re-priced to 74.40 (gross 80, trade discount 7% of 80 = 5.60), so SO-000004, INV-000004 and the journal carry 74.40; the customer is billed 7.44 too much and the 8.00 never appears (no scheme discount account line). `applied_pricing_schema_id` is stored on the line, but the recalculation ignores it. Also the trade discount base differs: 7% of 72 (after scheme) on the ASE screen, 7% of 80 afterwards. (S1 is therefore wrong in one sense: schemes do apply on the ASE screen, but not on the Sales form, and not after coordination.) CASHBACK AS WELL: SD-000008 ASE review 83.30, after Confirm Quantities 88.20 (cashback 5.00 gone). Only Promo free goods survive.
